cues.text: Outside the dorm, Koromaru sits beside you. The girl in the floral shirt and the naughty-looking boy run up to him.
The children run off, and the woman who knew Koromaru at the shrine walks up.
The woman has gone. An old man walks up the street toward you.
The old man has sat down, and you play shogi with him, Koromaru beside you. Mitsuru walks over from the dorm.
Koromaru runs off toward the old man's voice, and you follow.
